parameters.name: ExtraInfo
parameters.description: The additional information in JSON string format. This parameter is optional.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The natural language description of the question.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: The session ID in UUID string format. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, a new session is created. To maintain context across a conversation, use the same session ID.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The cloud service source that specifies which cloud service the question belongs to. This parameter is optional. Default value: yaochi.
